subject: POC reframe: add intents + SLA tweak — proposed acceptance & owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@retailco.com>, Amit Shah <amit@shopwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners (next steps)

Hi Elena / Amit —

Thanks again for the conversation today — great to hear more about the search/chat use cases and the specific business metrics you want to impact (AOV uplift and contact deflection). Per our call, I wanted to put the proposed POC baseline on paper so we can move quickly on internal approvals. Please read through and flag anything you'd like changed before EOD Thursday 11/26.

Proposed POC baseline (30-day trial)
- Scope: Search suggestions + cart-assistant chat (goal: answer product questions, reduce returns).
- Success criteria (baseline):
  - Intent classification accuracy >= 90% (on sample eval set)
  - Top-1 response relevance (human eval) >= 82%
  - Average inference cost < $0.005/token (estimated)
- Evaluation plan:
  - We’ll run a 5k-session synthetics + 1k anonymized live sessions sample.
  - Weekly checkpoints: model perf, latency percentiles, and qualitative examples.
- Timeline: kickoff 12/01, ingest & mapping week 1, model tuning week 2, live evaluation weeks 3–4, final review 12/30.
- Ownership:
  - Redwood: Karthik (trial lead), Ben (infra + logs), Marissa (success metrics / QA)
  - RetailCo: Elena (business owner), Amit (technical lead), Procurement contact for contracting

Attachments: proposed-poc-worksheet-v3.xlsx (worksheet with eval matrix), data-access-checklist.pdf

Immediate ask: please confirm the acceptance criteria and timeline or suggest changes by 11/26 so we can align infra and legal.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@retailco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@shopwave.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners (next steps)

Thanks Karthik — overall this looks good. A couple of items we want to change before we lock the plan: 

1) Add two additional intents: "returns_flow" and "product_finder" — both are high priority for our CS deflection goals.
2) Tighten latency SLO: we need 95th percentile inference latency < 250ms for live sessions (our UX lead flagged anything higher as unacceptable).
3) Data access: can you confirm whether Redwood needs a full product catalog dump or whether a streaming API will work for live sampling? We prefer API if possible.

We can approve the baseline once those are accounted for — feel free to propose how this changes the timeline/cost.

Best,
Elena Russo
Head of Digital Experience | RetailCo
elena.russo@retailco.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@retailco.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@shopwave.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners (next steps)

Elena — thanks, noted. Quick readout on impact and a proposed re-frame: 

Impact of additions
- Adding returns_flow and product_finder increases dev/mapping work (~3–4 extra mapping days) and means we need to expand the sample eval set by ~1k sessions.
- Latency SLO to 95th < 250ms is achievable on our hosted path but depends on sequence length distribution; we recommend enabling Redwood's KV-prefix caching and a slightly higher batching ceiling for live sampling.

Proposed re-baseline (revised POC)
- Scope: search suggestions, cart-assistant chat + returns_flow + product_finder intents.
- Acceptance criteria (revised):
  - Intent classification accuracy >= 92% (on RetailCo eval set)
  - Top-3 rerank precision >= 88% (human eval on 600 samples)
  - 95th percentile inference latency < 250ms (live sample config)
  - Cost delta: estimated +12% on infra for extended eval set and cache warming
- Timeline: shift final review to 01/13/2027 (extend trial by 2 weeks); proposed kickoff still 12/01 but with a heavier mapping/tuning window (weeks 1–3).
- Owners: same as baseline, Ben to provision cache-aware config and Marissa to run top-3 precision human evals.

Internal ask: I need sign-off on the +2 week extension and the small infra delta so we can notify Ops and Legal. Marissa / Ben — can you confirm feasibility and whether the data-access model (API) is OK?

-Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elena Russo <elena.russo@retailco.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Re: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners (next steps)

Karthik / Ben — quick internal note and ok to confirm externally: 

- Ben: provisioning cache-aware runtime for a RetailCo trial is doable; estimate +10–14% infra ops for the first 2 weeks (warm-up + hot prefixes).
- Monica: can you confirm whether security needs any additional forms for API ingestion vs dump? If not, Marissa will coordinate the human eval pool.
- I approve the +2 week extension on the condition we update the mutual action plan (MAP) with the new acceptance criteria and a short addendum on infra delta / pricing.

Ben — can you draft the MAP addendum and attach to the worksheet? I will route to Legal for a quick sign-off (procurement@retailco.com will need the DocuSign link).

-Marissa

Subject: Final: confirmed POC reframe + action items (owners & dates)

Elena / Amit — thanks for the quick responses. Per internal approvals, we’re confirming the re-baselined POC with the following final plan: 

Finalized scope & acceptance
- Scope: search suggestions, cart-assistant chat, returns_flow, product_finder.
- Acceptance: intent >= 92% (RetailCo eval set), top-3 precision >= 88% (600 eval samples), 95th percentile live latency < 250ms.

Timeline (key dates)
- 12/01: kickoff & data access (RetailCo provides API creds) — action: Amit (provide API + data schema)
- 12/01–12/21: ingest, mapping, model tuning (Ben to provision cache configs by 12/03)
- 12/22–01/05: live sampling & human evals (Marissa to lead human eval by 12/28)
- 01/13/2027: final performance review and decision

Action items (owners)
- Amit Shah: deliver API access and sample catalog by 12/01
- Ben Carter: enable KV-prefix caching and provide infra report by 12/03
- Marissa Cole: coordinate human evals and deliver top-3 precision report by 12/28
- Karthik Iyer: finalize MAP addendum, push DocuSign, and run weekly check-ins (Wednesdays 11am PT)

Procurement note: Ben attached the MAP addendum to the worksheet — procurement@retailco.com, please review for signature. Deal id RWD-2345 for reference.

Next meeting: 12/08 11:00am PT (30m) — agenda: data handoff status + infra readiness.

If that all looks good I’ll send the DocuSign link and calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.
Karthik
